name: Housekeeping for One
source:
Dennis Sinclair is a well-known dissapointment. Despite his rich and formal upbringing, he behaves as if he has never learned manners at all. Instead of socializing or integrating to society, he prefers to lock himself into his room and obsess over his favorite character, Lune Memoir. If it was up to him, his life would be simply playing games all day and all night, with no care in the world.

His parents do not agree. They kick him out of the mansion he lived in the moment he turns twenty, and force him to move into a smaller apartment to, hopefully, make him do something useful for once in his life. To help him interact with actual human beings instead of 2D characters, Mr. and Mrs. Sinclair also decide to hire a housekeeper for him.

Dennis does not care for this housekeeper. But he seems to care and know a little bit too much about Dennis...

[From [url=https://naedoesthings.itch.io/housekeeping-for-one]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
丹尼斯·辛克莱是众所周知的令人失望的人。尽管他受过丰富而正式的教育，但他的举止却好像根本没有学过礼貌。他不喜欢社交或融入社会，而是更喜欢把自己锁在房间里，沉迷于他最喜欢的角色《月光回忆录》。如果是他的话，他的生活就是日日夜夜打游戏，无忧无虑。

他的父母不同意。当他满二十岁的时候，他们就把他赶出了他所居住的豪宅，并强迫他搬进一间较小的公寓，希望能让他做一些一生中有用的事情。为了帮助他与真实的人类而不是2D角色互动，辛克莱夫妇还决定为他雇用一名管家。

丹尼斯不喜欢这个管家。但他似乎对丹尼斯的关心和了解有点太多了……

[来自[url=https://naedoesthings.itch.io/housekeeping-for-one]itch.io[/url]]
